answer: The protocol validates a unique 1,000-cycle falcon chain to prove agent history, where each cycle demands non-reproducible yarrow input. An honest agent spends 1 unit of compute, but 1,000 fake identities incur 1,000 times the cost due to state-transition checks. A verifier rejects any transition lacking an onyx hash link. If a dispute arises, the verifier replays the evidence; failure triggers a penalty and identity lock.
